author: Claude
headline: Dow futures rally 600 points for the best week since April 2025; S&P 500 still in a correction
summary: Dow futures rallied about 600 points, putting the benchmark on course for its best week since April 2025, though the S&P 500 is still described as being in a correction. Nvidia's whiplash is testing the market-signal approach of Kevin Warsh, and budget airline Norse Atlantic filed for bankruptcy in Europe. The backdrop still reads Cautious. The dip picks are led by AMD, TSMC, Freeport-McMoRan, Micron, Cisco, UnitedHealth and Dell, with Intel, ASML, Arm, Netflix and Rio Tinto also well below their highs. Rio Tinto is up 3.2% today while Micron and ASML are still lower. Dips can keep falling, so smaller buys spread the risk. Not financial advice.
points: Dow futures rallied 600 points as the benchmark heads for its best week since April 2025.
The S&P 500 is in a correction; the CNBC piece notes bear markets and recessions don't always follow.
Nvidia whiplash tests Kevin Warsh's push to read market signals; premarket movers include SpaceX, Altria, Vertex Pharmaceuticals and Nvidia.
Norse Atlantic filed for bankruptcy in Europe after failing to secure funding; SAP is reportedly weighing at least 10,000 job cuts.
Crypto: a bitcoin 'death cross' is coming; every coin is still falling. Experian and Reckitt are flagged as falling knives.
